Functions

## Fit a two-group graded response model with the given items held equal across groups
fit_model <- function(data, invariant_items) {
  multipleGroup(
    data = data[, phq_items],
    model = 1,
    group = data$sample_fct,
    itemtype = "graded",
    invariance = c(invariant_items, "free_means", "free_var"),
    verbose = F
  )
}


## Expected item scores on a theta grid by item and group; models[[j]] is the model used for item j
expected_scores <- function(models) {
  theta_grid <- seq(-5, 5, .01)

  expand_grid(item = 1:9, group = groups) %>%
    pmap(function(item, group) {
      item_parameters <- extract.item(extract.group(models[[item]], group), item)

      tibble(
        theta = theta_grid,
        item = item,
        group = group,
        ev = expected.item(item_parameters, theta_grid)
      )
    }) %>%
    bind_rows()
}


## Test-level DIF: HMS minus NHANES expected total score, averaged over HMS respondents' EAP thetas
test_level_impact <- function(model, curves) {
  theta_hat_hms <- fscores(extract.group(model, "HMS"), method = "EAP")[, 1]

  tcc_gap <- curves %>%
    group_by(theta, group) %>%
    summarize(total = sum(ev), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = total) %>%
    mutate(
      theta = round(theta, 2),
      gap = HMS - NHANES
    )

  tibble(theta = round(theta_hat_hms, 2)) %>%
    left_join(tcc_gap, by = "theta") %>%
    summarize(
      STDS = mean(gap),
      UTDS = mean(abs(gap))
    )
}


## Fit all three schemes; return effect sizes, curves, latent means and impact
run_schemes <- function(data) {

  # Models: all items equal; empirical anchors; theory-driven anchors
  models <- list(
    inv = fit_model(data, phq_items),
    emp = fit_model(data, c("phq_4", "phq_5")),
    the = fit_model(data, c("phq_1", "phq_2"))
  )

  # Main scheme: release each item in turn
  released_models <- map(1:9, ~ fit_model(data, phq_items[-.x]))

  # Item-level effect sizes (Meade, 2010)
  effect_sizes <- list(
    inv = map2(released_models, 1:9, ~ empirical_ES(.x, focal_items = .y) %>% rownames_to_column("item")) %>%
      bind_rows(),
    emp = empirical_ES(models$emp, focal_items = 1:9) %>% rownames_to_column("item"),
    the = empirical_ES(models$the, focal_items = 1:9) %>% rownames_to_column("item")
  )

  # Expected item scores
  curves <- list(
    inv = expected_scores(released_models),
    emp = expected_scores(rep(list(models$emp), 9)),
    the = expected_scores(rep(list(models$the), 9))
  )

  # HMS latent mean and SD
  latent_means <- models %>%
    map(~ coef(.x, simplify = T)$HMS) %>%
    map(~ tibble(mean = .x$means[1], sd = sqrt(.x$cov[1, 1]))) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "scheme")

  # Test-level impact
  impact <- map2(models, curves, test_level_impact) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "scheme")

  # Individual-level impact: DIF-adjusted vs naive theta
  theta_naive <- fscores(models$inv, method = "EAP", full.scores.SE = T)
  salient_threshold <- median(theta_naive[, "SE_F1"])

  individual_impact <- models[c("emp", "the")] %>%
    map(~ tibble(
      sample = data$sample_fct,
      theta_naive = theta_naive[, "F1"],
      theta_adjusted = fscores(.x, method = "EAP")[, "F1"]
    )) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "scheme") %>%
    mutate(diff = theta_adjusted - theta_naive) %>%
    group_by(scheme, sample) %>%
    summarize(
      r = cor(theta_naive, theta_adjusted),
      mean_diff = mean(diff),
      sd_diff = sd(diff),
      max_abs_diff = max(abs(diff)),
      pct_salient = mean(abs(diff) > salient_threshold),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  list(
    models = models,
    effect_sizes = bind_rows(effect_sizes, .id = "scheme"),
    curves = bind_rows(curves, .id = "scheme"),
    latent_means = latent_means,
    impact = impact,
    individual_impact = individual_impact,
    salient_threshold = salient_threshold
  )
}

## Tidy one DIF() result
tidy_dif <- function(test) {
  test %>%
    rownames_to_column("item") %>%
    select(item, X2, df, p)
}

## Difference between two nested tests (omnibus minus the other)
difference_test <- function(omnibus, other, df) {
  tibble(
    item = rownames(omnibus),
    X2 = omnibus$X2 - other$X2,
    df = df,
    p = pchisq(X2, df = df, lower.tail = F)
  )
}

Depression Prevalence by Screening Methodology

options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")

## Screening definitions (each a 0/1 indicator)
add_screens <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      phq_2_sum = phq_1 + phq_2,
      n_criteria = rowSums(across(phq_1:phq_9, ~ . >= 2)),
      screen_phq9 = as.numeric(phq_sum >= 10),
      screen_phq2 = as.numeric(phq_2_sum >= 3),
      screen_phq2_phq9 = as.numeric(phq_2_sum >= 3 & phq_sum >= 10),
      screen_algorithm = as.numeric(n_criteria >= 5 & (phq_1 >= 2 | phq_2 >= 2))
    )
}

screen_labels <- c(
  screen_phq9 = "PHQ-9 ≥ 10",
  screen_phq2 = "PHQ-2 ≥ 3",
  screen_phq2_phq9 = "PHQ-2 ≥ 3 and PHQ-9 ≥ 10",
  screen_algorithm = "DSM-5 algorithm"
)


## Survey designs
# NHANES: build on all cycles, then subset to 2021-2023 (as in Analysis.Rmd)
nhanes_design <- svydesign(
  data = df %>% filter(sample_fct == "NHANES") %>% add_screens(),
  ids = ~ psu, strata = ~ strata, weights = ~ weight, nest = TRUE
) %>%
  subset(most_recent_survey)

# HMS 2021-2023: survey year as strata, schools nested within year as clusters, nonresponse weights
hms_design <- svydesign(
  data = df_recent %>% filter(sample_fct == "HMS") %>% add_screens(),
  ids = ~ psu, strata = ~ year, weights = ~ weight, nest = TRUE
)


## Weighted prevalence (logit CIs) by screening definition and sample
designs <- list(NHANES = nhanes_design, HMS = hms_design)

prevalence <- expand_grid(
  sample = names(designs),
  screen = names(screen_labels)
) %>%
  mutate(
    est = map2(sample, screen, ~ svyciprop(as.formula("~" %+% .y), designs[[.x]], method = "logit")),
    prevalence = map_dbl(est, as.numeric),
    lower = map_dbl(est, ~ confint(.x)[1]),
    upper = map_dbl(est, ~ confint(.x)[2]),
    sample = factor(sample, levels = names(designs)),
    screen = factor(screen_labels[screen], levels = screen_labels)
  ) %>%
  select(-est)
## Warning: There were 8 warnings in `mutate()`.

## Table: prevalence (95% CI) by sample, plus HMS / NHANES ratio
prevalence_table <- prevalence %>%
  mutate(estimate = percent(prevalence, .1) %+% " (" %+% percent(lower, .1) %+% ", " %+% percent(upper, .1) %+% ")") %>%
  select(screen, sample, estimate, prevalence) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = c(estimate, prevalence)) %>%
  mutate(ratio = round(prevalence_HMS / prevalence_NHANES, 1)) %>%
  select(screen, NHANES = estimate_NHANES, HMS = estimate_HMS, ratio) %>%
  arrange(screen)

prevalence_table %>%
  format_table(
    "Weighted prevalence of a positive screen, % (95% CI); NHANES 2021-23, HMS 2021-23",
    col.names = c("Screening method", "NHANES", "HMS", "HMS / NHANES")
  )
Weighted prevalence of a positive screen, % (95% CI); NHANES 2021-23, HMS 2021-23
Screening method NHANES HMS HMS / NHANES
PHQ-9 ≥ 10 12.6% (11.1%, 14.4%) 42.2% (41.2%, 43.2%) 3.3
PHQ-2 ≥ 3 11.1% (9.7%, 12.7%) 31.8% (31.0%, 32.7%) 2.9
PHQ-2 ≥ 3 and PHQ-9 ≥ 10 7.9% (6.7%, 9.3%) 28.6% (27.8%, 29.4%) 3.6

## Plot: prevalence (95% CI) by screening method and sample, with HMS / NHANES ratio
ratio_x <- ceiling(max(prevalence$upper) * 20) / 20 + .02 # Ratio column sits just right of the widest CI

prevalence_plot <- prevalence %>%
  ggplot(aes(prevalence, fct_rev(screen), color = sample)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), linewidth = .6) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_text(
    data = prevalence_table,
    aes(x = ratio_x, y = fct_rev(screen), label = "× " %+% sprintf("%.1f", ratio)),
    inherit.aes = F,
    hjust = 0, size = 8 / .pt
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = ratio_x, y = length(screen_labels) + .5, label = "HMS ÷ NHANES",
    hjust = 0, size = 7.5 / .pt, color = "grey35"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = sample_colors,
    labels = c(NHANES = "NHANES 2021–23", HMS = "HMS 2021–23")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Weighted prevalence of a positive screen (95% CI)",
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, ratio_x + .05),
    breaks = seq(0, floor(ratio_x * 10) / 10, .1)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Positive Screens by Screening Method and Sample") +
  theme_style() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = .3))

prevalence_plot

save_figure(prevalence_plot, "2021-23 HMS vs 2021-23 NHANES - Prevalence by Screening Method", height = 3.2)
